title: Rust Developer
description: A roadmap for Rust development covering ownership, systems programming, CLIs, web services, async, testing, performance, and safe deployment.

tree.name: Rust Foundations
tree.description: Learn ownership, borrowing, lifetimes, traits, enums, pattern matching, cargo, and compiler-guided development.

children.name: Ownership, Traits, and Error Handling
children.description: Use ownership rules, references, Result/Option, traits, generics, modules, crates, and idiomatic errors.

children.name: Collections and Iterators
children.description: Use vectors, hash maps, strings, slices, iterators, closures, pattern matching, and data modeling.

tree.name: CLIs and Web Services
tree.description: Build useful command-line tools and web APIs with configuration, parsing, async runtimes, databases, and JSON.

children.name: CLI Tools
children.description: Parse arguments, read files, handle errors, format output, write tests, and publish installable binaries.

children.name: Web APIs
children.description: Use Axum or Actix, async Rust, middleware, extractors, validation, PostgreSQL, and structured errors.

children.name: Practice: Ownership Refactor
children.description: Refactor a small parser to remove clones, model errors cleanly, and add benchmarks.

tree.name: Quality, Performance, and Systems
tree.description: Use Rust for reliable software through tests, benchmarks, profiling, unsafe boundaries, and interoperability.

children.name: Testing and Benchmarks
children.description: Write unit, integration, property, and snapshot tests; add benchmarks and fuzzing for critical code.

children.name: Unsafe Rust and FFI Basics
children.description: Understand unsafe blocks, memory layout, FFI, C interop, and how to keep unsafe code isolated.

tree.name: Deployment and Portfolio
tree.description: Package Rust binaries, build containers, document tradeoffs, and show why Rust was the right tool.

children.name: Release Engineering
children.description: Manage features, workspaces, cross-compilation, CI, binary releases, Docker images, and semantic versioning.

children.name: Project: Fast Log Analyzer
children.description: Build a Rust CLI/API that parses logs, summarizes errors, benchmarks performance, includes tests, and publishes binaries.
